text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. 3rd Stage is about to begin! 
This round will decide which athlete 
Umamusume advance to the year-end finals!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Let's take another look at the featured 
contenders! First up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 3rd Stage had finally arrived. The 
venue was even more lively than in the 
previous qualifiers, and all eyes were on 
who would advance to the finals—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
We're finally competing at the same venue! 
I can totally feel your intense fighting 
spirit from over here!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Let's both give it our all so we can 
advance to the finals!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sononet Elfie appeared, and with a single 
glance, it was clear her condition and 
spirit were brimming with immense 
power...!
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir! I'll be in your care!!
